name: fix-preexisting-failing-smokes-story2
title: Story #2: fix the ~25 preexisting failing smokes on main (test:all exit 0)
description: Update stale assertions across ~25 failing smokes so npm run test:all (and npm run test:coverage) exit 0 cleanly. Production code is NOT touched — only smoke assertion text / regex / enum is realigned to current production output. If a failing smoke is rooted in a real production bug, the implementer files a finding and the bug is split to a follow-up story. Closes the B-c6cf CHK-002:happy:2 waiver.
